svg.title: Validate a DataFrame before it poisons the table: a pandera schema and a quarantine bin
svg.desc: a pandera schema gate as a rigid frame with a narrow slit that lets a clean data row continue down a cool path while a bad row is diverted into a warm quarantine bin, all inside the 1000×1000 frame. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Validate a DataFrame before it poisons the table: a pandera schema and a quarantine bin”. A isometric lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 3036769386.
